# heparamotor.ru — Knowledge Base for Paramotor Pilots

## About
Independent informational platform for Russian-speaking pilots
using HE Paramotores engines. Not a seller, distributor, or agent.

## What we provide
- Technical documentation (translated from manufacturer manuals)
- Engine comparison data (6 models, 80-277cc)
- Spare parts catalog (108 items, with part numbers)
- AI-assisted diagnostics
- Maintenance calculators and reminders
- Configuration guidance

## What we do NOT do
- We do not sell engines or parts
- We do not import or export products
- We do not act as agent for HE Paramotores S.L.
- We do not process payments for products

## Engines (6 models)
MVL 125 — 125cc, compact, 73kg thrust
MV1 185 — 184.70cc, 25 HP, 13.4kg
MV2 204 — 204cc, 29 HP, bestseller, dual start
Raptor 250 — 277cc, 25 HP, max thrust 77kg
RS-185 — 185cc, 26 HP, new RS series
RS-206 — 206cc, 29 HP, flagship RS

## AI Tools
- Engine selector (recommendation by weight/budget/experience)
- Diagnostic assistant (symptom -> cause -> fix)
- Maintenance calculator (hours -> service checklist)
- Parts finder (description -> part number)
- Maintenance reminder (serial number -> Telegram notification)
